exposure: laparoscopic radiofrequency ablation of uterine leiomyomas
cohort: Premenopausal women older than 21 years with symptomatic uterine leiomyomas who underwent either laparoscopic radiofrequency ablation or myomectomy.
finding: Full-term pregnancy and vaginal delivery are achievable after radiofrequency ablation of leiomyomas, and no significant differences were found in the likelihood of live birth or miscarriage when compared to myomectomy in this interim analysis.
mod_finding: Among live births in the radiofrequency ablation group, 45.5% were by vaginal delivery, indicating that vaginal delivery is achievable after the procedure.
